name: Loadstar Capital K.K.
summary: Loadstar Capital K.K., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate investment business in Japan. The company invests in various real estate properties, including middle sized office buildings and hotels; sources, procures, invests, and manages assets; and operates OwnersBook, a real estate investment crowdfunding platform. It is also involved in asset management; money lending; real estate rental; hotel management contract; and financial products trading businesses, as well as development and provision of blockchain infrastructure and digital securities. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
